cues.en: Now, the last method that we are going to implement for Q is going to be the clear method.
Now, we have said that when we are calling the clear method for Q, it's going to delete all elements
of the Q.
Now to be able to do that, we are just going to declare the clear method.
So here when we are deleting the all elements from the Q, all we have to do is we're just going to
set the head and tail reference to point to null, and then to point to zero, because in case of the
empty q the q is like this.
So you can just go ahead and copy this code from here and pass it inside the clear method.
So I'll just go down.
So this is going to be very easy method because we are just putting the Q in an initial version.
So we are deleting the link from front to the first node, then link from end to the first node.
And all nodes will be collected from the garbage collector, because there is no any external reference
to this node.
And the link has to be zero, because when the q is empty, the length is zero.
Now if I just go ahead and run this.
So I'll just put clear method.
So let me just delete this part and run our code.
So we can just go ahead and put my Q to the console like this.

So it's obvious that the time and space complexity for clear method also is going to be zero one, because
here we are not performing any time consuming operation and an additional memory is not required.
That's why time and space complexity is O one.
